policy: Each published article has a distinct relevant image. Original post media is used when accessible and verified; otherwise an individually generated editorial illustration is used. The same article can reuse its own image across site placements.
sourceNotes: Public LinkedIn source pages were accessed without authentication. Profile discovery pages returned access restrictions and were not bypassed.
LI-003: unrelated recommended-post images were rejected. A dedicated illustration is used.
LI-009: original document-cover request returned HTTP 403; a dedicated illustration is used.
Generated illustrations are conceptual artwork and do not depict actual people, clinical results, branded devices or events.
Three distinct topical images from the original practice website are retained for the existing non-LinkedIn articles.
